stem: After meter verification and recipe reconciliation, a fertigation batch still falls outside its approved acceptance criteria. What should happen next?
choices: Make undocumented adjustments until it matches
Release it because the recipe was followed
Hold or escalate it under the defined procedure rather than forcing acceptance
Change the acceptance criteria for this batch
rationale: A verified out-of-acceptance result requires documented disposition or escalation, not hidden adjustment or ad hoc criteria changes.
